title: Slicing a lava apple 🌋🍎
description: Hot or not? 🔥 Sound on 🔊 What should we cut next?

scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 video, 8 seconds. An apple made of black cooled lava crust with glowing orange cracks sits on a black stone. A knife slowly cuts through the crust. Style: macro close-up, studio lighting, pure black background, ultra realistic, 4k, slow motion, crisp detailed ASMR cutting and crackling sounds, no music, no voice. Audio: Rough crunchy crust crackling, a deep hiss of heat.

Vertical 9:16 video, 8 seconds. The halves separate and reveal bright molten orange lava inside, bubbling and glowing, small embers floating up. Style: macro close-up, studio lighting, pure black background, ultra realistic, 4k, slow motion, crisp detailed ASMR cutting and crackling sounds, no music, no voice. Audio: Bubbling and sizzling sounds, soft crackle of embers.
